hook.text: The Cayman Islands has 100,000 companies registered but only 65,000 residents. Something doesn't add up.

buildup.text: Tax havens offer near-zero corporate tax. Companies route profits through them to avoid paying at home.

discovery.text: Ireland charged Apple an effective rate of 0.005% on European profits. That's $50 on $1 million.

twist.text: Tax havens are legal. Countries compete for registrations. It's a global race to the bottom.

climax.text: In 2021, 136 nations agreed to a 15% global minimum tax. The loopholes are slowly closing.

quiz.question: What did 136 nations agree to in 2021?
